data.name: Deeptiman
data.gender_notes: Deeptiman is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from Sanskrit 'Deep' meaning 'deep' and 'Timan' meaning 'mind'. It is a name given to a child who is believed to have a profound mind or deep understanding. The name Deeptiman carries the meaning “Deep Minded” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Deeptiman usually hope their child will grow to embody deep minded and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Deeptiman total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
